extraction.ownership_guide_prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. Keep only the complete original running gray quadruped in the upper margin, including its full narrow snout, both ears, each source-visible paw and the entire long tapering tail. Remove the red/blue/gold page border under it and all paper. Retain the source pose and uncertain species; no new horns, mane, anatomy or restored hidden paws. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.

review.notes: Compared the full original region and a native close-up of the hind paw on white and dark backgrounds. Original opaque RGB and original proportions retained, genuine exterior clear.
